cards.ex: The company decided to contest the ruling, claiming the evidence was flawed.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya dalillar noto'g'ri ekanligini da'vo qilib, qarorga e'tiroz bildirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudning qaroriga rozi bo'lmaslik va uni o'zgartirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: This could be a precedent-setting case that affects environmental regulations for years to come.
cards.exUz: Bu kelajakda atrof-muhit qoidalariga ta'sir qiluvchi namunaviy ish bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi shunga o'xshash ishlar uchun qoida yaratuvchi sud ishi.

cards.ex: After months of legal wrangling, the two companies finally reached a settlement.
cards.exUz: Oylik huquqiy tortishuvlardan so'ng, ikki kompaniya nihoyat kelishuvga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Huquqiy masalalar bo'yicha uzoq va murakkab bahslar.

cards.ex: The appeals court decided to uphold the conviction, denying his request for a new trial.
cards.exUz: Apellyatsiya sudi hukmni tasdiqlashga qaror qildi va uning yangi sud jarayoni bo'yicha so'rovini rad etdi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori sudning quyi sud tomonidan chiqarilgan hukmni to'g'ri deb topishi.

cards.ex: After deliberating for two days, the jury was finally able to reach a verdict.
cards.exUz: Ikki kunlik muhokamadan so'ng, hay'at nihoyat hukmga kela oldi.
cards.uzDef: Sud hay'atining sud ishi bo'yicha yakuniy qarorga kelishi.

cards.ex: They signed a binding agreement that committed them to five years of collaboration.
cards.exUz: Ular ularni besh yillik hamkorlikka majbur qiladigan majburiy kelishuvga imzo chekishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy kuchga ega bo'lgan va bajarilishi shart bo'lgan kelishuv.

cards.ex: Anyone caught vandalizing public property is liable to prosecution.
cards.exUz: Davlat mulkiga zarar yetkazgan har qanday shaxs ta'qibga duchor bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bo'yicha jinoiy javobgarlikka tortilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: As citizens, we must all abide by the law, regardless of our personal opinions.
cards.exUz: Fuqarolar sifatida, shaxsiy fikrlarimizdan qat'i nazar, barchamiz qonunga rioya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlarni hurmat qilish va ularga bo'ysunish.

cards.ex: The judge imposed a stiff penalty on the defendant, given the severity of the crime.
cards.exUz: Sudya jinoyatning og'irligini hisobga olib, ayblanuvchiga qattiq jazo tayinladi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir va qattiq jazo.

cards.ex: He exercised his right of appeal, hoping the higher court would overturn the verdict.
cards.exUz: U yuqori sud hukmni bekor qiladi degan umidda apellyatsiya huquqidan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Sud qaroriga rozi bo'lmagan shaxsning yuqori sudga shikoyat qilish huquqi.

cards.ex: The lawyer argued that there was no legal precedent for this type of case.
cards.exUz: Advokat bu turdagi ish uchun huquqiy pretsedent yo'qligini ta'kidladi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi sud qarorining kelajakdagi shunga o'xshash ishlar uchun asos bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The witness testified under oath, promising to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth.
cards.exUz: Guvoh qasamyod ostida haqiqatni, faqat haqiqatni gapirishga va'da berib ko'rsatma berdi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni gapirishga va'da berib.

cards.ex: The contract had a clause with questionable legality, so we consulted a lawyer.
cards.exUz: Shartnomada shubhali qonuniylikka ega band bor edi, shuning uchun biz advokat bilan maslahatlashdik.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir qonuniy ekanligiga shubha borligi.

cards.ex: The Supreme Court's decision was a landmark ruling that changed the way the law was interpreted.
cards.exUz: Oliy sudning qarori qonun talqinini o'zgartirgan muhim qaror edi.
cards.uzDef: Huquq sohasida katta o'zgarishlarga olib keluvchi muhim sud qarori.

cards.ex: The authorities decided to prosecute him for fraud.
cards.exUz: Rasmiylar uni firibgarlikda ayblab, jinoiy ish qo'zg'atishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni jinoyatda ayblab, sudga berish.

cards.ex: The company conducted due diligence before investing in the startup.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya startapga sarmoya kiritishdan oldin tegishli tekshiruvlarni o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir qaror qabul qilishdan oldin kerakli tekshiruvlarni o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The bank agreed to waive the late payment fee as a gesture of goodwill.
cards.exUz: Bank yaxshi niyat bilan kechiktirilgan to'lovdan voz kechishga rozi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: To'lovni bekor qilish yoki undirmaslik.

cards.ex: Victims of the scam are seeking legal redress through a class-action lawsuit.
cards.exUz: Firibgarlik qurbonlari jamoaviy da'vo orqali qonuniy himoya izlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Huquqiy yo'l bilan adolatni tiklashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He was charged with perjury after lying on the stand.
cards.exUz: U sud zalida yolg'on gapirganidan keyin yolg'on guvohlikda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Sudda qasamyod ostida yolg'on gapirish.

cards.ex: The company was found liable for damages caused by the defective product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya nuqsonli mahsulot tufayli etkazilgan zarar uchun javobgar deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning zarariga to'lashga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: They reached an out of court settlement to avoid a lengthy and expensive trial.
cards.exUz: Ular uzoq va qimmat sud jarayonidan qochish uchun sudsiz kelishuvga erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Sudga bormasdan tomonlarning kelishishi.

cards.ex: She decided to file a lawsuit against her former employer for discrimination.
cards.exUz: U sobiq ish beruvchisiga qarshi kamsitish uchun da'vo arizasi berishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudga rasmiy ravishda shikoyat arizasi topshirish.

cards.ex: The document was full of legal jargon that was difficult for the average person to understand.
cards.exUz: Hujjat oddiy odam tushunishi qiyin bo'lgan huquqiy jargon bilan to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Huquq sohasi mutaxassislari tomonidan ishlatiladigan murakkab va tushunarsiz til.

cards.ex: They tried to circumvent the law by exploiting a technicality.
cards.exUz: Ular texnik xatolikdan foydalanib qonundan chetlab o'tishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunni buzmasdan, uning ta'siridan qochish yo'lini topish.

cards.ex: The judge ruled the evidence inadmissible because it was obtained illegally.
cards.exUz: Sudya dalillarni qonunga xilof ravishda olinganligi sababli qabul qilib bo'lmas deb topdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudning dalillarni qabul qilmaslik haqida qaror chiqarishi.

cards.ex: The judge declared a mistrial after a juror was found to be biased.
cards.exUz: Sud hay'ati a'zosi xolis emasligi aniqlangandan so'ng, sudya samarasiz sud e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sud jarayonining xato tufayli bekor qilinishi va yangi sudning tayinlanishi.

cards.ex: The company could face legal action if they continue to pollute the river.
cards.exUz: Agar kompaniya daryoni ifloslantirishni davom ettirsa, huquqiy choralarga duch kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Sudga berilishi yoki huquqiy muammolarga duch kelishi mumkin bo'lish.

cards.ex: They managed to settle the dispute through mediation.
cards.exUz: Ular vositachilik orqali bahsni hal qilishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bahsni kelishuv yo'li bilan hal qilish.

cards.ex: They served him a subpoena to testify in the upcoming trial.
cards.exUz: Ular unga bo'lajak sud jarayonida guvohlik berish uchun chaqiruv qog'ozini topshirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudga kelishni talab qiluvchi rasmiy qog'ozni topshirish.

cards.ex: The decision could have serious legal ramifications for the company.
cards.exUz: Ushbu qaror kompaniya uchun jiddiy huquqiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bilan bog'liq har qanday harakatning mumkin bo'lgan natijalari.
